golden.name: Golden spiral
golden.description: A logarithmic spiral that grows by the golden ratio with every quarter turn.

phyllotaxis.name: Phyllotaxis
phyllotaxis.description: The arrangement of leaves around a plant stem. Spiral arrangements often follow the golden angle, creating patterns like those in sunflower seed heads.

lorenz.name: Lorenz attractor
lorenz.description: A butterfly-shaped pattern traced by a chaotic system of three equations, originally developed to model atmospheric convection.

sierpinski.name: Sierpiński triangle
sierpinski.description: A fractal made by repeatedly removing the central triangle from an equilateral triangle, leaving smaller copies of the same shape.

chladni.name: Chladni nodal patterns
chladni.description: Patterns formed when particles collect along the still nodal lines of a vibrating surface, making sound vibrations visible.

dragon.name: Dragon curve
dragon.description: A fractal curve built by repeatedly folding a line through right angles, creating a pattern that repeats at smaller scales.
